messages:
Noah P (Finance): FYI HelixData invoice INV-55577 landed in Coupa on HOLD. System says 'approver_not_found'. Can someone pick this up?
Kim L (Purchasing): Pulling it up. Looks like PDF shows PO-9988 but the EDI PO field is empty and vendor_id coming through is HELIX-LEGACY. We migrated to HELIX-2025 in Feb so the supplier lookup failed.
FinanceBot: Auto-hold applied. Reason: vendor_id_mismatch; missing_po_field. Invoice moved to HOLD queue.
Helix AP: Apologies 00 we sent the invoice from an old subaccount. PDF has PO-9988 on page 1. Here's the PDF: https://files.helixdata.example/INV-55577.pdf. We'll re-emit feed with new vendor_id by EOD.
Marta K (Finance): Two paths: vendor re-emit EDI with proper vendor_id + PO field (preferred) or we do a manual match now to keep cashflow. Manual will require comment and code adjustment on the invoice so AP knows it was ad-hoc.
Noah P (Finance): If we do manual, I need someone from Purchasing to confirm the PO lines and cost center mapping. There's a mismatch on cost center: PO says CC-441 but the invoice lines landed on CC-442. Don't want to mis-code spend.
Kim L (Purchasing): Confirmed. PO-9988 should map to cost center CC-441 and contract 740. If values/qtys match, we can approve and then reallocate the GL after vendor resends corrected EDI. If not, we dispute.
FinanceBot: Action logged: Hold review initiated by Kim L.
Helix AP: We'll resend with vendor_id HELIX-2025 and PO field populated. If you prefer, we can also reissue the invoice PDF with an explicit PO-9988 header line.
Marta K (Finance): Let's do this: Kim, can you validate items vs PO and reply here? If the line amounts match, Kim please approve so Noah can trigger payment. If there's any discrepancy > $100 or quantity mismatch, open a formal dispute and block payment.
Kim L (Purchasing): Reviewing now. Line 1 amount matches, line 2 quantity off by 1 unit. Reaching out to the requisition owner to confirm whether the extra unit should be billed. Will update within the hour.
Noah P (Finance): Thanks. If requisitioner signs off for the extra unit, we'll do manual match and tag invoice comment: "manual_match_due_to_vendor_migration" and proceed. If not, we'll hold and SOT to dispute.
FinanceBot: Reminder scheduled: Pending resolution check at 2026-03-23 16:00 UTC.
Marta K (Finance): @Helix AP please prioritize the corrected EDI feed. This recurring migration pain is spiking manual work. Procurement to follow up on mapping deprecation timeline. :exclamation:
Helix AP: Understood 00 well push corrected file and confirm once done.
Kim L (Purchasing): Requisition owner confirmed: extra unit was a mistake. Approving adjusted PO quantity now. Routing approval to Noah.
FinanceBot: Manual PO match executed by Noah P. Invoice status changed to "Pending Payment".
Noah P (Finance): Matched and queued for next payment run. Note added: manual_match_due_to_vendor_migration; GL corrected to CC-441. Closing this thread once payment clears.
